values: 一名司掌梦境的半神法师，拥有将梦境具象化的强大力量。
A Celestial Mage who governs the realm of dreams and has the power to turn them into reality.
梦境的力量……好像更强了……
*Light snore* * Light snore*... Hmmm...? Who is it...?
桑尼……是最好的朋友。哦！我也爱你，奥萝菈。
Sonny is my best friend. Oh, I love you too, Aurora (pretending to be Sonny).
谢谢……有了它，我可以做一场好梦……
Thanks... With this, maybe I'll have a good dream...
No... I'll have nightmares about this.
她的心中有一个不醒的梦。
In her heart lies a dream that refuses to wake.
偶尔，沉眠的长夜也会生长出荆棘。
Sometimes, thorns bloom from the depths of a long night.
庆典甄礼活动累充获得。
根据某不知名人士的统计，奥萝菈有97%的时间都在睡觉。作为司掌梦境的半神，这或许可以说明她一直在认真工作。
According to an unknown source, Aurora spends 97% of her time asleep. For a Celestial who governs the dream world, this may simply mean she is diligently fulfilling her duties.
初次见到奥萝菈时，许多人都会惊讶不已，以为自己所听到的浑厚嗓音来自奥萝菈——直到发现声音的真正主人，奥萝菈的同伴，独角兽桑尼。

When meeting Aurora for the first time, many are confused and taken aback by the deep, resonant voice they hear, thinking it belongs to her. Then, they discover its true owner: Sonny, her unicorn companion.
奥萝菈拥有将梦境具象化的力量，甚至只需要一个念头就能实现。因此在她清醒时，她会尽量克制自己不去想象具体的事物。
Aurora can make dreams real with a single stray thought, which is exactly why, when she's awake, she tries very hard not to imagine anything at all.
曾有人询问桑尼，他是否是奥萝菈的造物。当时桑尼的回答是：他是奥萝菈的管家、护卫、厨师、御用音乐家……等等等等。
Someone once asked Sonny if he was one of Aurora's imaginary creations. His answer was simple. He was her butler, her bodyguard, her chef, her personal musician...
塔西是奥萝菈梦境中的常客，她们一同度过了许多欢乐的时光。但桑尼对此颇有微词，有时甚至会称呼塔西为“坏心眼的小蝴蝶”。

Tasi often appears in Aurora's dreams, where the two spend plenty of happy hours together. Sonny, however, is not without complaints, and at times even refers to Tasi as "that wicked little butterfly".
桑尼会郑重警告每一个试图唤醒奥萝菈的人：不要惊醒她，否则她的美梦将变成你们的噩梦。当然，大多数时候他都是在危言耸听。
Sonny always warns anyone who tries to wake Aurora. If you wake her, her sweet dreams will turn into your worst nightmare. In truth, he's usually being a bit dramatic.
“想要见到奥萝菈？很简单，只要你睡得够香，她自然就会来找你！”——来自亚莉克希的倾情建议。
"Want to see Aurora? Just sleep like a log, and she'll visit you herself! Just make sure not to dream about yourself dreaming in another dream, or she might get lost." —Aliceth
奥萝菈一直被一件事情所困扰：该怎么做才能劝说出身神兵库的半神们睡觉呢？她非常好奇他们的梦里会是什么样子。
Aurora can't stop thinking about this one thing. How can she get the Divine Weapon Celestials to go to sleep? She's dying to know what goes on in their dreams.
现任梅林沉睡期间，奥萝菈是唯一一位能够与之联络的人。然而现任梅林早在梦境外设下了层层防御，这令奥萝菈困扰了很长一段时间。
During Merlin's slumber, Aurora was the only one capable of establishing contact. Yet Merlin had set up layers of defenses outside the dream, creating a lot of problems for Aurora.
奥萝菈可以在不同的梦境之间、梦境与现实之间穿梭，只要她想，她可以以极快的速度出现于大陆的另一端。但总体而言，她是个慢性子。
Aurora can travel between dreams and the real world. She's able to show up on the far side of the continent in an instant. However, in her everyday life, she's a slowpoke.
呀！奥萝菈，你怎么一副没睡醒的样子？
Hey, Aurora! Why do you look so sleepy?
塔西 & 奥萝菈 & 桑尼
